candidates.statement: Gateway checkout returns 502 after ~2s because its call to order times out (transport ReadTimeout); order's own call to payment also times out at ~2s, so payment authorization latency propagates up and fails checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show payment ReadTimeout but no payment-side telemetry; exact slow dependency not directly observed.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s align with ~2s client timeouts on gateway->order and order->payment calls; traces show payment ReadTimeout and order transport errors. Bounded to downstream latency; payment-side evidence still needed to pin the slow hop.
